shots.actions: the safe door closes and the law strip is locked into the reinforced cloister, the last line of cold light in the door gap going out; a readout field in one corner shows the normalisation readout at 1.2% while the led board in the far market direction scrolls several price entries
shots.layout_and_occlusion: 3 visible instances. Dominant ReinforcedCloister covers 100x100 percent at frame 50/50. Left to right: GreyFramePanel, SteelSafe, ReinforcedCloister.
shots.lighting_spatial_logic: one cold overhead key over the purification bench with shadow detail retained instead of crushed black, cold grey bounce from concrete and steel, the welding arc, the twin flame and the fire heads as the only moving light sources, and the emergency lamp as the sole light after the yard lights are cut
